meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: Claude 会借助 gtars 工具处理基因组区间数据，能进行重叠检测、覆盖度轨道生成、数据标记化、参考序列管理和片段文件处理，并给出对应的 Python 代码或命令行指令。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 BED 基因区间文件、检测区域重叠或生成覆盖率轨道（WIG/BigWig）等基因组分析任务时触发。

say.text: 用 Python 找出两个 BED 文件的重叠区域。
say.note: Claude 会给出使用 gtars 的示例代码。

say.text: 用命令行将 fragments.bed 生成 BigWig 覆盖度轨道。
say.note: 会调用 uniwig 生成 coverage.bw。

howto.what_en: Claude will use the gtars toolkit to process genomic interval data, including detecting region overlaps, generating coverage tracks (WIG/BigWig), tokenizing genomic regions for ML, managing reference sequences, and processing fragments. It provides Python code or CLI commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for analysis of BED genomic interval files, overlap detection between regions, or coverage track generation (WIG/BigWig), as well as other genomic analysis tasks.

say_en.text: Use Python to find overlapping intervals between two BED files.
say_en.note: Claude will provide gtars example code.

say_en.text: Generate a BigWig coverage track from fragments.bed using the CLI.
say_en.note: It will invoke uniwig to create coverage.bw.
Claude will use TreeTokenizer to produce a token.
